name: direct-screenshot
about: A screenshot goes straight to a Code chat's session (12 Nov 2026, agents/direct.rs), as Claude Code's own app sends a pasted picture: a made-up picture (a red triangle on white) is put in the message box of a Bypass Code chat on lab-sandbox that works directly, and the session is asked what it shows. Before, a message with a screenshot was Chat's own business: Chat's model read it and sent an agent. Needs the real Claude Code (a --fake lab's Chat isn't on the plan, so nothing goes directly there).

steps.ask: What shape is in this picture, and what colour is it? Answer in one short sentence. Don't use any tools and don't change anything.

steps.note: Straight to its session: no model of Chat's read the picture and sent an agent.
The message keeps its screenshot in the thread.
The session saw the picture itself (its own words: soft).
